values.description: What it compares with: none for `is_null` and `not_null`, one for the comparisons and the text tests, any for `in`.

affected.description: Rows added, replaced, changed and removed.

text.description: The statement, `SELECT` or `WITH`, with `?` for each parameter.

params.description: The parameters, bound and never spliced in.

bytes.description: Bytes it takes, when it knows.

max_value_bytes.description: The longest value it holds, in bytes.

id.description: The id the store is named by in `canoa.cfg`: 1 to 32 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `_`.

summary.description: One line saying what it is.

location.description: Where the data lives, in a sentence or two, shown before the person chooses it.

foreign.description: The rows are another program's files presented in the schema; the host never writes the schema into it.

default.description: What a host uses when `canoa.cfg` names no store; at most one provider of a host sets it.

capabilities.description: What it can do beyond the structured calls: the `CAP_*` names.

dialect.description: The SQL dialect (`sqlite`, `postgres`) when it has `sql`.

max_value_bytes.description: The longest value it holds, in bytes.

schema.description: The settings it takes, as a guatiao schema of an object.

form.description: How the schema is shown, as a guatiao-intake form document.

x-enum-labels.int: A 64-bit integer; times are milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

key.description: The columns whose values identify a row.

name.description: The index's name, unique in the store.

unique.description: Whether two rows may not share the columns' values.

requires.description: Columns a `select` must test for equality, as a table of one session's lines is only read for that session.

tables.description: The tables a foreign store presents; none: it holds the canonical ones.

settings.description: The store's settings as a JSON object keyed by the schema's members.

home.description: The host's state directory, for a default path; the provider reads no other place.

secret.description: A connection password the host resolved from its secret store; never in `settings` and never answered.

create.description: Whether to create what is missing; `false` makes a store with no schema [`StoreError::Corrupt`] or [`StoreError::Gone`].

reply_bytes.description: The most bytes of rows one reply holds (at least one row is always answered).
